reason: The document is an investor presentation ('Alstom's Equity Story July 2025') that provides market data but does not disclose a Total Addressable Market (TAM) figure originated by Alstom itself. The presentation references 'Alstom addressable market' of €38bn average per year (2024-2026) for Rolling Stock & Components (page 12), citing WRMS 2024 and UNIFE as sources. These are external third-party market research providers, not company-disclosed TAM. The document states this figure 'excludes freight wagons, and China, Russia, Japan, South Korea and Iran' and shows a CAGR of 2.6% based on UNIFE data. Since the TAM figures rely on external analyst/research firm data (WRMS, UNIFE) rather than Alstom's own market assessment disclosed in SEC-equivalent filings, this does not meet the strict requirement that the company itself must have disclosed the TAM in its official filings.
